changesets.summary: Reject sign-in messages that only embed expected fields
changesets.details: `verify_sign_in` used to accept a signed message when the requested fields appeared anywhere in the text. A wallet could put a different domain on the first line, or hide a transfer inside the statement, and still pass. Verification now parses the message the way `@solana/wallet-standard-util` does: the preamble must be the first line, every field the app set must match, and a field the app left unset must be absent. Domain and address may still be omitted; the wallet fills them in and the account is checked against the message.

## [0.7.5](https://github.com/pina-rs/wallet_standard/releases/tag/v0.7.5) (2026-11-18)

Grouped release for `core`.

### Fixes

- **Reject sign-in messages that only embed expected fields.** `verify_sign_in` used to accept a signed message when the requested fields appeared anywhere in the text. A wallet could put a different domain on the first line, or hide a transfer inside the statement, and still pass. Verification now parses the message the way `@solana/wallet-standard-util` does: the preamble must be the first line, every field the app set must match, and a field the app left unset must be absent. Domain and address may still be omitted; the wallet fills them in and the account is checked against the message.
  _Packages:_ 🟢 _wallet_standard_
  _Owner:_ [@ifiokjr](https://github.com/ifiokjr) · _Review:_ [PR #86](https://github.com/pina-rs/wallet_standard/pull/86)
